fixtures: controlComp('neon-blue-ocean', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / neon B3 / helm B3 vs the Fire boss, focus neon, deterministic (no seed). B1+B2 are mandatory: a lone Burst III unit casts ZERO bursts, which would make both escalations, the swap and the rider vacuous. The fixed B3 (helm) is KEPT rather than dropped for two reasons: (1) every magnitude claim is a BASE-vs-patched delta on the same 5-unit comp, so helm's buffs cancel; (2) a SECOND stage-3 caster is exactly what lets skill2's team-wide stageEnter{3} out-fire skill1's own-burst trigger, which is the only in-fixture handle on trigger identity. The boss being Fire is load-bearing twice over — it opens the burst rider's bossElementGate, and Water-vs-Fire keeps skill2's elemental-advantage buff live so its removal is measurable. Seven hoisted runs total (BASE + 6 counterfactuals), each a full 180s sim.
